symptom: When every configured Python candidate fails the focused-test dependency probe, _focused_test_command still emits a pytest command using the unverified scheduler interpreter.
root_cause: The candidate selection passed sys.executable as the default value to next(), bypassing _python_supports_focused_tests when no candidate matched.
fix_diff:
diff --git a/成都修茈科技有限公司/MODstore_deploy/modstore_server/self_maintenance_loop_runner_part06_part01_part01.py b/成都修茈科技有限公司/MODstore_deploy/modstore_server/self_maintenance_loop_runner_part06_part01_part01.py
index c518cdd51..af9c73cc9 100644
--- a/成都修茈科技有限公司/MODstore_deploy/modstore_server/self_maintenance_loop_runner_part06_part01_part01.py
+++ b/成都修茈科技有限公司/MODstore_deploy/modstore_server/self_maintenance_loop_runner_part06_part01_part01.py
@@ -295,8 +295,13 @@ def _focused_test_command() -> str:
             for candidate in candidates
             if candidate and _facade()._python_supports_focused_tests(candidate)
         ),
-        _facade().Path(_facade().sys.executable),
+        None,
     )

+        raise RuntimeError(

+def test_focused_test_command_selects_later_verified_candidate(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.delenv("MODSTORE_SELF_MAINTENANCE_FOCUSED_TEST_COMMAND", raising=False)
+    monkeypatch.setenv("MODSTORE_SELF_MAINTENANCE_TEST_PYTHON", "/override/python")
+    monkeypatch.setenv("MODSTORE_DEPLOY_ROOT", "/deploy")
+    monkeypatch.setenv("MODSTORE_RUNTIME_ROOT", "/runtime")
+    accepted = "/runtime/MODstore_deploy/.venv/bin/python"
+    probed = []
+
+    def supports_focused_tests(candidate):
+        probed.append(str(candidate))
+        return str(candidate) == accepted
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(loop_runner, "_python_supports_focused_tests", supports_focused_tests)
+
+    assert _focused_test_command().startswith(f"{accepted} -m pytest ")
+    assert probed == [
+        "/override/python",
+        "/deploy/.venv/bin/python",
+        accepted,
+    ]
+
+
+def test_focused_test_command_fails_closed_when_no_candidate_passes(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.delenv("MODSTORE_SELF_MAINTENANCE_FOCUSED_TEST_COMMAND", raising=False)
+    monkeypatch.setenv("MODSTORE_SELF_MAINTENANCE_TEST_PYTHON", "/override/python")
+    monkeypatch.setenv("MODSTORE_DEPLOY_ROOT", "/deploy")
+    monkeypatch.setenv("MODSTORE_RUNTIME_ROOT", "/runtime")
+    monkeypatch.setattr(loop_runner, "_python_supports_focused_tests", lambda candidate: False)
+
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="no Python interpreter passed"):
+        _focused_test_command()
+
